text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Bubble 
Gum Fellow...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Bubble Gum Fellow 
pointed, there was a claw machine filled 
with plushies designed after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Look, it's Paka Puchi! I've actually 
collected quite a few of these.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Hey, wanna play a bit? I'll snag it on the 
very first try, watch!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Just as aimed! Alright, it's your turn 
next, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Things like this are meant to be 
enjoyed together!

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm counting on you. Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
